title: 第二十五章 一键扫荡第二十六章 方舱梦
content_zh:
早上八点。
远越高校应届年级，正在组织到水星重工的参观。
一辆辆大巴车停在学校门口。
王庆找到了三班的大巴车位置。
“给，这是参观证，要一直带着，别弄丢了，否则会被驱离。”
班委眼镜娘找到有王庆寸照的吊牌，从一圈圈冰蓝色的系绳中挑出，递给了他。
“感谢。”
王庆接过参观证，捏在手里看了一眼，设计得还蛮不错，系绳的颜色和水星集团的logo色系是一致的。
水星重工是水星集团里最大的实业公司，集团下还涉猎房地产、娱乐传媒、互联网、金融能源等其它产业。
所谓的vi视觉识别系统么。
王庆为了解方舱的生态，下了一些工夫，懂得个中术语。
“你终于来了，这将是一场屠杀！”
刘子文突然窜出来。
虚界泰斗是什么概念，都被这神秘玩梗男吊起来打，今天下午那些货色，只能说塞牙缝都不够。
友谊赛还未开始，就已经结束了。
给远越高校争取到投资捐款，按照往年惯例，甚至有可能被水星集团高管收为弟子，那不是起飞了么？
王庆碉都不碉他，他没理解到自己昨天跟他说的话么？你对我来说没有价值，如此不识相。
刘子文眼睛边上都是黑眼圈，看起来精神抖擞，很有可能是熬了一晚上的夜。
“我已经给你占好座位了，双层大巴，一定要坐第二层，踏上无情的征服之路，就在今日，制霸灰核城所有高校，站上顶点。”
刘子文双手抱怀，无论安芷事件，还是d姐事件，都让他认为这哥们儿非同一般，必将潜龙腾渊，一发不可收拾。

“你好中二，不是很懂二次元民那的说。”
王庆架不住纠缠，盛情难却，只好接受邀约。
“你才更二次元吧喂！”
刘子文才奇怪王庆是怎么绷得住，一本正经说出极度弱智台词的。
十分钟后。
大巴开往水星集团旗下的水星重工。
三班一共六十来号学生，其中大多数比较反感这种无意义的活动，对自身成绩没有提升不说，还白白浪费时间。
只是大集团和大集团之间合作密切，今天的主要目的不是参观，而是让青春洋溢的学生过去作为拍照背景板，在记者的摄制下，宣传水星集团对方舱未来展望的大格局。
至于下午的友谊赛，整个灰核城那么多高校生，又有多少人是那块料，根本不抱希望。
双层大巴二层靠后座位。
“今天那家伙没来啊，怕不是已经死了。”
刘子文对班上同学的动态相当关注，或许是来自潜意识最深处的反馈机制，目睹到有人自杀或陷入困境后，自己却处于安全的境地，会莫名的舒缓压力。
他指的人自然不是安芷。
精英人才子女拥有特权，不需要考虑出勤率的，那天来学校，也只是安芷兴趣使然，出了这么大的事，被家里当宝贝，短时间是不会来学校的了。
见王庆依然玩着线上赌城不答话，刘子文强行说起单口相声，“就是昨天我给你指的那个，座位在倒数第二排靠窗，鼻青脸肿，眼睛都充血，多半在打地下擂台的人。”
大人物对修仙者一板一眼的体育斗法竞技表演，已经审美疲劳，渐渐失去兴趣。
当今苍州反而流行原始血腥拳拳到肉的死斗，血肉横飞刺激感官的暴力画面。
“地下擂台……”
王庆稍稍有了点兴致，之前听他说过，“虽然挣钱，苍州让打么？”
刘子文却露出一个你在逗我的表情。

不是跟他解释了一遍司法有无数种规避的方法么，其中医药公司的试药技术意外，就可以完美规避。
content_en:
Eight o'clock in the morning.
The graduating class of Yuanyue University is organizing a visit to Mercury Heavy Industry.
Buses parked in front of the school.
Wang Qing found the location of the third class bus.
"Here, this is your visitor's pass. You must keep it with you at all times. Don't lose it, otherwise you will be kicked out."
The bespectacled girl from the class committee found the tag with Wang Qing's photo on it, picked it out from the circles of ice blue rope, and handed it to him.
"Thank you."
Wang Qing took the visitor's pass, held it in his hand and took a look. It was quite well designed, and the color of the tether was consistent with the Mercury Group's logo.
Mercury Heavy Industries is the largest industrial company in the Mercury Group. The group is also involved in other industries such as real estate, entertainment media, Internet, finance and energy.
What is the so-called vi visual recognition system?
In order to understand the ecology of the shelter, Wang Qing spent some time and understood the terminology involved.
"You're finally here, it's going to be a massacre!"
Liu Ziwen suddenly jumped out.
What is the concept of being a master in the virtual world? He was hung up and beaten by this mysterious man. This afternoon, all those guys are not enough to squeeze through the teeth.
The friendly match was over before it even started.
Obtain investment donations for Yuanyue University, and according to previous years' practice, you may even be accepted as a disciple by Mercury Group executives. Wouldn't that take off?
Wang Qing didn't criticize him. Didn't he understand what he said to him yesterday? You are of no value to me, so ignorant.
There were dark circles around Liu Ziwen's eyes. He looked energetic, probably because he had stayed up all night.
"I have already reserved a seat for you. Make sure to sit on the second floor of the double-decker bus and embark on the ruthless road of conquest. Today, you will dominate all the universities in Gray Core City and stand at the top."
Liu Ziwen held his arms in his arms. Whether it was the An Zhi incident or the Sister D incident, he thought that this buddy was extraordinary and was bound to dive into the abyss and be out of control.
"Hello, you are a middle school student. I don't know much about the people of the second dimension."
Wang Qing couldn't stand the entanglement and couldn't refuse the warm invitation, so he had to accept the invitation.
"You just changed to the second dimension!"
Only then did Liu Ziwen wonder how Wang Qing could hold his nerve and say the extremely mentally retarded lines in a serious manner.
Ten minutes later.
The bus was bound for Mercury Heavy Industries, a subsidiary of Mercury Group.
There are about sixty students in the third class, and most of them are disgusted with such meaningless activities. They do not improve their grades and waste time in vain.
It’s just that there is close cooperation between large groups. The main purpose of today is not to visit, but to let the young students go over as a photo background and, under the camera of reporters, promote the future prospects of the Mercury Group’s cabin.
As for the friendly match in the afternoon, there are so many college students in Gray Core City, and how many of them are that material, there is no hope at all.
Seats at the back of the second floor of a double-decker bus.
"That guy didn't come today. I'm afraid he's dead."
Liu Ziwen pays close attention to the dynamics of his classmates. Perhaps it is a feedback mechanism from the deepest part of his subconscious. After witnessing someone committing suicide or getting into trouble, he is in a safe situation, which inexplicably relieves his stress.
The person he was referring to was naturally not An Zhi.
Children of elite talents have special privileges and do not need to consider their attendance. Coming to school that day was just out of An Zhi's interest. After such a big incident and being treated as a treasure by the family, she would not come to school for a short time.
Seeing that Wang Qing was still playing online gambling and didn't answer, Liu Ziwen forced himself to talk about stand-up comedy, "It's the one I pointed out to you yesterday. The seat is in the second to last row by the window. His nose is bruised, his face is swollen, and his eyes are bloodshot. He is probably playing in the underground ring."
The big shots were tired of the rigid sports and martial arts performances of the immortal cultivators and gradually lost interest.
Nowadays, Cangzhou is popular in primitive bloody fist fights to the death, with bloody and violent scenes that stimulate the senses.
"Underground arena..."
Wang Qing became slightly interested. He had heard him say before,"Although I am making money, will Cangzhou allow me to fight?"
Liu Ziwen showed an expression like "You're kidding me."
Didn't I explain to him that there are countless ways to circumvent the law, among which the pharmaceutical company's unexpected drug testing technology can be perfectly circumvented.
